! Sanitised IOS-XE running-config excerpt. All credentials are FAKE and annotated
! with the redaction rule id expected to catch it (see ios-xe.expect.json).
version 17.9
service password-encryption
hostname core-rtr-01
!
enable secret 9 $9$FAKEenableSECRETtype9/AbCdEfGh.1234567890            ! cisco-password-type
enable password 7 0822455D0A16FAKE7                                     ! cisco-password-type
!
username admin privilege 15 secret 5 $1$FAKE$adminSecretType5Hash1234   ! cisco-password-type
username backup privilege 15 secret 8 $8$FAKEsalt$backupType8HashXYZ    ! cisco-password-type
username monitor password 0 FAKEplainPassword123                        ! cisco-password-type
username legacy privilege 1 password FAKEtypelessPassword               ! generic-keyword
!
key chain ISIS-AUTH
 key 1
  key-string 7 FAKEkeyString0123456789                                  ! cisco-key-string
!
aaa new-model
aaa group server tacacs+ TACACS-GROUP
 server name TAC1
tacacs server TAC1
 address ipv4 10.20.30.40
 key 7 FAKEtacacsServerBlockKey0987                                     ! cisco-server-key
tacacs-server key 7 FAKElegacyTacacsKey1122                             ! cisco-aaa-server-key
radius-server key FAKEradiusPlainKey3344                                ! cisco-aaa-server-key
!
crypto isakmp key FAKEisakmpKey5566 address 203.0.113.1                 ! cisco-isakmp-key
crypto ikev2 keyring IKEV2-KR
 peer BRANCH
  address 203.0.113.2
  pre-shared-key local FAKEikev2LocalPsk7788                            ! ike-pre-shared-key
  pre-shared-key remote FAKEikev2RemotePsk9900                          ! ike-pre-shared-key
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 description uplink to border-rtr-01
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.252
 ip ospf message-digest-key 1 md5 7 FAKEospfMd5Key1357                  ! cisco-ospf-md5
 ip ospf authentication-key 7 FAKEospfAuthKey2468                       ! cisco-ospf-auth-key
!
router bgp 65000
 neighbor 192.0.2.2 remote-as 65001
 neighbor 192.0.2.2 password 7 FAKEbgpNeighborPassword8642              ! cisco-bgp-neighbor-password
 neighbor 192.0.2.6 remote-as 65002
 neighbor 192.0.2.6 password FAKEbgpPlainPassword9753                   ! cisco-bgp-neighbor-password
!
ntp authentication-key 1 md5 FAKEntpMd5Key1029 7                        ! ntp-authentication-key
ntp trusted-key 1
!
snmp-server community FAKEsnmpRoCommunity RO                            ! cisco-snmp-community
snmp-server community FAKEsnmpRwCommunity RW ACL-SNMP                   ! cisco-snmp-community
snmp-server host 10.20.30.50 version 2c FAKEsnmpHostCommunity           ! cisco-snmp-host
snmp-server location dfw1-row3
!
line vty 0 4
 password 7 FAKEvtyLinePassword5150                                     ! cisco-password-type
 login local
end
